name: Sheriff's Office
desc1: This is a stark and harshly furnished room. There is nothing but a
desc2: plain wooden desk and two chairs here. The city Sheriff sits behind
desc3: the desk, and nods as you enter. He looks hard, but is known to be
desc4: fair to those who deserve leniance. To the south you can see the
desc5: entrance hall, and there is a jail cell to the east.
